description:
This position performs full lifecycle software development activities (planning, requirements definition, analysis, design, coding, testing, documentation, training, implementation and support) of new client/server and web applications or maintenance and upgrade of existing applications. In addition, the employee will develop requirements and specifications; propose changes to or addition of business processes; analyze required information and data; support all fleet data management systems; work to ensure unique requirements are compatible with the FleetFocus host system; support, replace and enhance the suite of custom applications used by Equipment Services personnel; add to the existing solutions base as major projects are identified; and provide PC end user support  

 

 *Programming application using VB.NET, JavaScript, HTML and SQL Server  
 *Building reports and using Crystal Reports  
 *Using Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft Visual Sources Safe, and Microsoft Office products  
 *Oral and written communication  
 *Troubleshooting, analysis, and resolution of technical issues  

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
- All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply.
 - Most of our positions require Candidate to clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
